I can't say whether the property is legally compliant. The evidence doesn't make any regulatory or compliance finding, including on EUDR or deforestation-free status.

What it does show for ASSET-B (2,843.1 ha):
- No tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected between 2021-01-01 and 2025-12-31. Hansen data covered the whole asset.
- One small loss of 0.4 ha in 2021 fell below the 0.5 ha event threshold, so it wasn't counted.
- Smaller changes, changes at edges, or changes narrower than the 30 m pixels may have been missed.
- JRC mapped 0 ha of forest in 2020. Hansen shows 23 ha of tree cover in 2000.
- Earlier loss, before the baseline, included 67.7 ha in 2020. It is outside the claim period, but you may want to review it.

A compliance conclusion would need legal criteria, such as the applicable regulation, land-use rules, and supply-chain or permit information, which this evidence doesn't cover.
